verdict.rationale: Termius docs mention AI-generated shell commands from plain-language descriptions (docs-6), which is a form of AI suggestion, but there's no evidence of AI-generated insights derived from the user's own data (e.g., analyzing session logs, host activity, or infrastructure patterns) — autocomplete (docs-11, docs-24) is rule/history-based, not AI-driven. missing for 10: AI analysis/insights over session logs or infrastructure data, dashboards or summaries generated from user data, independent/hands-on corroboration of the AI command feature.
